current: Photo hero with crest and club name, a next-match hero plus league card, then a three-column body of ~11 text-heavy sections (availability, contracts/radar, results, news, weekly plan, board, rivals, other results, training note). Weekly plan duplicates the board card and news; nothing below the hero is ranked.
reason: Today's Paper is the only concept that both ranks (lead story + numbered decisions) and de-duplicates (weekly plan becomes the Week Spine, news becomes briefs, board appears once). Its lead story switches with the Continue state, so matchday, board review, transfer deadline and season end each get their own front page without new data. A's queue is embedded as the decision column, so power users lose nothing.
dependencies: G2 navigation model (hub rail + Week Spine + Peek)
Continue state machine (label mutates: Fortsätt → Förbered match → Till matchen)
WLD-01 inline resolution (decision column reuses inbox actions)
Event chain presentation (careerEventId → message → decision → consequence)

alternatives.name: Decision Briefing
alternatives.concept: The manager's morning briefing: a ranked queue of what needs you ('3 saker kräver dig i dag'), each item resolvable in place, above a four-tile KPI strip. Everything informational is one click away, nothing is navigation-by-tile.
alternatives.layout: KPI strip (Tabellplats, Spelbara x/16, Förtroende, Budgetutrymme) → two columns: ranked decision queue (7/12) and next-match card with countdown (5/12) → a thin 7-day strip → three compact cards (mini table ±2 rows, last results, board objectives).
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Number of open decisions and the top one; 2) next match and days left; 3) KPI deltas since last visit; 4) week strip.
alternatives.interactions: Each queue row has its primary verb inline (Förläng, Välj startsju, Svara styrelsen) with a consequence line; j/k + Enter keyboard flow; resolved rows collapse with a FLIP animation; KPI tiles open a hover card explaining the delta.
alternatives.navigation: Lives at Idag hub root. KPI tiles do not navigate (inform vs navigate); each has an explicit 'Öppna' link. Continue in the top bar shows the blocked count from the same queue.
alternatives.desktop: Dense 12-col grid, sticky KPI strip, tabular numerals, hover cards on every player/club name.
alternatives.mobile: Sticky Continue bar at bottom; queue first as swipe-to-resolve cards; KPI strip becomes a 2×2 grid; mini table and results move behind 'Mer i dag'.
pros: Fastest route from login to action
Directly answers the 'no primary focus' weakness
cons: Least emotional — matchday feels like any other day
Season-end and dismissal moments need a separate takeover
Risk of feeling like a SaaS to-do app

d: KPI strip: Tabellplats · Spelbara · Förtroende · Budgetutrymme|12|panel

alternatives.name: Matchweek Show
alternatives.concept: The dashboard is the opening of a TV broadcast for this round: a full-bleed next-match hero with both crests in club colours and a live countdown, a news ticker, and four 'storyline' cards that frame the week (player in form, injury worry, board mood, rival watch).
alternatives.layout: Full-bleed hero (crests face-off, competition mark Handbollsligan/Svenska Cupen/SM-slutspel, countdown, form strips) → ticker band (other results, transfers) → storyline card row (4) → decision tray as a lower-third → league table panel.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) The match and the countdown; 2) storylines; 3) decisions in the lower-third tray.
alternatives.interactions: Storyline cards flip to show the underlying data (e.g. 'Lindqvist 31 mål på 5 matcher' → stats); ticker items open Peek; decision tray expands upward like a broadcast lower-third.
alternatives.navigation: Top hub bar; hero CTA becomes 'Förbered match' and leads into the matchday sequence. Storylines deep-link to SQD/MED/CLB-05.
alternatives.desktop: Cinematic 16:9 hero, glass panels, club-colour re-tint.
alternatives.mobile: Vertical card stack: hero card, then one storyline per swipe; decisions as a badge on the central Continue button.
pros: Strongest emotional pull and screenshot value
cons: Decisions are secondary — easy to miss deadlines
Weeks without matches (international break, off-season) feel empty
Asset-hungry; storylines need good copy generation
needs new data: storyline selection heuristic (presentation layer only)

alternatives.name: Today's Paper
alternatives.concept: The front page of the club journal for today's in-game date. A lead story is chosen from game state (matchday preview, yesterday's result, board verdict, deadline day, injury crisis), a numbered decision column sits beside it, and the week runs across the top as the Week Spine. Board confidence and manager reputation sit in the masthead 'ears' as a dual meter.
alternatives.layout: Masthead (Klubbjournalen · <Klubb> · Vecka 12, tisdag 14 jan) with ears: left Förtroende, right Rykte → Week Spine → lead story (8/12) + numbered decisions 'Att avgöra' (4/12) → match box + mini ladder ±2 + availability court → 'Runt ligan' briefs + 'Från klubben' briefs.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Lead headline (the one thing that matters today); 2) numbered decisions with deadlines; 3) next match box; 4) briefs.
alternatives.interactions: Decisions resolve inline (same components as the inbox reader); briefs open Peek; lead story's 'Läs mer' opens the article or match report; the masthead ears hover-explain the last change ('−4 efter 24–29 mot Kristianstad').
alternatives.navigation: Idag hub root. Continue advances the Week Spine; the next day's paper replaces this one (yesterday's papers live in Karriär → Säsongsbok). Lead stories link to their source surface (match report, CLB-05, transfers).
alternatives.desktop: Newspaper grid with rules instead of boxes, serif headlines, Peek drawer on the right preserves the page.
alternatives.mobile: 'Morning paper' feed: lead story card, then decisions as numbered cards with sticky action, Week Spine as swipeable strip at top, briefs last.
pros: Lead switches with moment (matchday, board review, window) — personalisation without new systems
Gives every day a memory: past papers feed career history
cons: Editorial quality depends on headline templates from game events
Two layers (lead + decisions) must never disagree about priority
Needs the Week Spine component first

current: Photo hero with manager-office image, 64px crest, overline 'MANAGERNS KONTOR · season', club name H1, league/venue/capacity and two link chips (Klubbhuset, Taktikrummet). Purely decorative — carries no live state.
reason: The masthead turns a decorative banner into the place where long-term state lives (date, phase, board confidence, reputation) at almost no height cost, and it is the natural anchor for the Today's Paper concept.
dependencies: Season phase label from the season state machine

alternatives.name: Status Bar
alternatives.concept: Replace the hero with a 56px status bar: club stripe + crest, in-game date, season phase ('Grundserie · omgång 14 av 22'), and the Continue label.
alternatives.layout: Single row: crest · club · phase · date | spacer | Continue button with blocked-count badge.
alternatives.hierarchy: Date/phase first, Continue second, club identity third.
alternatives.interactions: Phase label opens the season hub (MGR-03); date opens the calendar; Continue explains blockers on hover.
alternatives.navigation: Becomes part of the global shell rather than the page.
alternatives.desktop: Fixed under top bar; never scrolls away.
alternatives.mobile: Collapses to crest + date; Continue moves to bottom bar.
pros: Always-visible phase answers 'where am I in the season?'
patterns: Play menu as season state machine

alternatives.name: Live Arena Masthead
alternatives.concept: Keep a photographic hero but make it alive: countdown to next match, opponent crest, board mood glow colour, and the arena image switching by phase (training hall in the week, arena on matchday, trophy room at season end).
alternatives.layout: Full-width photo band; left: crest + club + heritage; right: countdown block 'Om 2 dagar · Kristianstad (B)'.
alternatives.interactions: Countdown click → match preview; mood tint hover → board summary.
alternatives.navigation: Page-level; dissolves into the hub bar on scroll.
alternatives.desktop: 320px band with parallax disabled under reduced motion.
cons: Still costs vertical space every visit
Image switching needs image set per phase (exists partly)

alternatives.name: Journal Masthead
alternatives.concept: A newspaper nameplate: 'KLUBBJOURNALEN · <Klubb>' with issue line ('Vecka 12 · tisdag 14 januari · Grundserie omg 14'), and two ears — left ear Förtroende (board, this club, short-term), right ear Rykte (manager, career, long-term) — each with the last delta and its reason.
alternatives.layout: Three-part row: left ear | nameplate + issue line | right ear; thin club-colour rule beneath.
alternatives.hierarchy: Nameplate/date, then the two ears' deltas.
alternatives.interactions: Ears hover/long-press explain 'why it moved' from board factors and reputationLog; nameplate opens the club journal (CLB-02).
alternatives.navigation: Top of Idag only; other hubs use a smaller running head with the same date.
alternatives.desktop: ~120px; serif nameplate; ears as mini gauges.
alternatives.mobile: Nameplate shrinks to one line; ears become two chips under it.
pros: Introduces the long-term/short-term dual meter everywhere it matters
cons: Editorial tone must be maintained in other hubs
Two meters can be confused without labels

current: MatchHero (two crests, date, competition) beside an aside with rank '#/N', points/matches/goal difference and last-5 form dots. No table context, no countdown, no injury impact.
reason: The match box answers 'how ready are we and what is at stake' in one block: opponent form, our absentees and the ladder slice. It stays compact enough to sit beside the lead story.

alternatives.name: Fixture Card + Ladder Slice
alternatives.concept: A compact fixture card and, beside it, the league table sliced to ±2 rows around your club with zone colours (SM-slutspel, kval, nedflyttning).
alternatives.layout: Card: crests, H/B, date, countdown, competition; table: 5 rows + header.
alternatives.hierarchy: Opponent and days left; then your row highlighted in the slice.
alternatives.interactions: Row hover → club hover card; 'Hela tabellen' link.
alternatives.navigation: Links to match preview and competition.
alternatives.mobile: Card first; ladder slice below as 5 compact rows.
pros: Gives table context the current card lacks

alternatives.name: Pre-match Bug
alternatives.concept: A broadcast pre-match graphic: crests face-off in club colours, both teams' last-5 form strips, head-to-head line and a 'Saknas' row with faces of injured/suspended players.
alternatives.layout: Wide band: home crest | VS + countdown | away crest; second row: form strips; third: Saknas chips.
alternatives.interactions: Absentee chip → player Peek; 'Förbered match' primary.
alternatives.navigation: Primary entry to the pre-match ritual.
alternatives.mobile: Stacks; crests shrink; absentees as horizontal scroll.

alternatives.name: Match Box
alternatives.concept: An editorial 'Matchrutan': fixture headline ('Lördag: Kristianstad borta'), a readiness line ('13 spelbara · 2 skadade · 1 avstängd'), opponent form and the ladder slice, with the opponent opening in Peek.
alternatives.layout: Boxed column: headline + countdown, readiness line with icons, opponent form strip, ladder ±2.
alternatives.interactions: Opponent name → Peek dossier; readiness → availability court; 'Förbered match' starts the 3-step ritual.
alternatives.navigation: Sits under the lead story; becomes the lead itself on matchday.

current: ClubHero + milestone section ('Säsongen är i mål.') with three facts (final place, points, goals); transition blockers rendered as an alert list exposing internal codes (b.ref).
reason: Season end is the biggest recurring emotional beat and today it is a text card. A skippable Floodlight curtain that ends by writing the season into the career biography makes progression felt, and blockers become human tasks instead of codes.
dependencies: Human-readable blocker copy for transition codes

alternatives.name: Season Hand-off Checklist
alternatives.concept: A calm summary followed by a transition checklist: each blocker rewritten as a task with a fix link ('3 kontrakt löper ut — Se över avtalen').
alternatives.layout: Summary strip (place, points, goals, board verdict) → checklist → 'Börja nästa säsong' disabled until done.
alternatives.interactions: Each task resolves in place or deep-links; progress bar.
alternatives.navigation: Replaces dashboard body until the season is started.

alternatives.name: Season Curtain
alternatives.concept: A skippable Floodlight sequence the first time you land after the last match: lights down, final position counts up, trophy/promotion/relegation asset, top scorer, board verdict stamp, reputation delta — ending on a season card that is 'filed' into Karriär. Afterwards the dashboard shows the checklist.
alternatives.layout: Full-screen stages (5–8 s total, Space to skip): Final position → Honours → Board verdict → Rykte → Season card + 'Arkivera och fortsätt'.
alternatives.hierarchy: Position/honour, then verdict, then career delta.
alternatives.interactions: Click/Space advances; 'Hoppa över' always visible; final card animates into the Karriär icon.
alternatives.navigation: Returns to Idag with the hand-off checklist.
pros: Creates the career history artefact visibly

alternatives.name: Special Edition
alternatives.concept: The day after the final whistle the paper prints a special edition: season review headline, table of the season in numbers, best match, and blockers as 'Att göra före nästa säsong'.
alternatives.layout: Paper front page variant with large headline + numbered blockers.

current: Inline note strips with a bold lead and a link, used identically for very different stakes (unemployed vs. new season).
reason: Being without a club is a career state, not a notice. Letting the Idag hub turn into a job-hunt front page (and a new season into a pre-season front page) gives each state its proper weight.

alternatives.name: Tone-tiered Notices
alternatives.concept: Three notice tiers — info (paper), milestone (gold), crisis (signal/Floodlight) — each with an icon, headline and one CTA.
cons: Unemployment still feels like a banner

alternatives.name: State Front Pages
alternatives.concept: Career states replace the dashboard body: 'Utan klubb' front page (days unemployed, reputation, open vacancies matched to your standing, applications pipeline), 'Ny säsong' front page (board objectives meeting, pre-season planner, squad changes).
alternatives.layout: Same masthead; body swaps to a state template.
alternatives.hierarchy: State headline → the 2–3 actions that move you out of it.
alternatives.interactions: Apply / answer interview / plan pre-season inline.
alternatives.navigation: Continue keeps advancing time while unemployed; offers arrive as decisions.
pros: Unemployment becomes playable, not a dead end
patterns: Play menu as season state machine

dependencies: Squad positional depth data (already in CLB-02 depth tiles)

alternatives.name: Availability Ring

alternatives.navigation: Links to tactics line-up and medical.
alternatives.mobile: Full-width court, positions large enough to tap (44px).

alternatives.concept: No panel. Contract deadlines and scouting reports become numbered items in 'Att avgöra' when they cross a threshold (e.g. <60 days); otherwise silent.

alternatives.interactions: Row → room's page or Peek; filter 'Bara avvikelser'.
alternatives.navigation: Becomes the Klubben hub's secondary index.

alternatives.name: Illustrated Clubhouse
alternatives.concept: An isometric illustrated building whose look follows the facility tier (local/pro/elite assets exist, unused). Rooms show notification badges; a single tap opens a room Peek with status, metrics and the CTA.

alternatives.interactions: Tap room → Peek; long-press for preview on touch; tier upgrade plays a short reveal.
alternatives.navigation: Klubben hub landing for B identity.
alternatives.mobile: Pannable illustration with a room list toggle (accessible fallback).
cons: Map accessibility needs a list twin

alternatives.layout: Club Journal header = clubhouse illustration with hotspots; body = journal sections.
alternatives.hierarchy: Club identity → departments needing attention → history.
alternatives.interactions: Hotspot → Peek (single tap); 'Visa som karta' expands the header to full screen.
alternatives.navigation: Removes a nav item; /career/klubbhuset redirects to Klubben.
alternatives.mobile: Header image static; hotspots replaced by department chips.

cons: Map is less central for players who loved it

reason: Single-tap to a Peek drawer works on every input device and keeps context; the illustrated map is the identity payoff.

alternatives.name: Illustrated Map + Peek

alternatives.interactions: Tap/Enter opens; arrow keys move between rooms.
alternatives.navigation: Peek 'Öppna rummet' goes to the room's page.
alternatives.mobile: Map pans; Peek as bottom sheet.

alternatives.name: Room List + Stage
alternatives.concept: A vertical room list (status dot, name, one-line status) drives the photo stage; the floorplan is dropped.

reason: The gallery is a third way into the same rooms; removing it reduces duplication. Status belongs in the map/Peek and the Today decisions.

alternatives.name: Retire the Gallery
alternatives.concept: Remove the cards; map/header hotspots + Peek cover entry, and alerts flow to Idag.
alternatives.navigation: Rooms reachable via hub rail and Peek.

alternatives.name: Status Chip Row
alternatives.concept: A compact chip row (room name + status dot + count) under the map for quick scanning.

current: Three panels: identity facts with colour swatches; supporter MeterBar + rivals list + honours list; national team windows with dates/opponents/called players.
reason: Identity, supporters and honours are the club's story; an almanac page inside the journal shows them as history, while national windows belong on the calendar.

alternatives.name: Fact Sheet
alternatives.concept: Tidy definition-list fact sheet with colour swatches, supporter meter and lists.

alternatives.name: The Stand
alternatives.concept: Supporters as a stand: tifo banner in club colours with the supporter mood meter, derby cards for rivals (last result, next meeting), honours as a trophy shelf.
alternatives.interactions: Derby card → CLB-04; trophy → season in history.

alternatives.name: Club Almanac
alternatives.concept: An almanac section of the Club Journal: founding, colours, home arena, honours timeline (year + title), supporters' mood with its causes, rivals with head-to-head; national windows move to the calendar as pins.
alternatives.mobile: Single column with sticky section heads.
cons: Honours timeline thin for small clubs at start

current: ClubHero, 4-cell facts strip, ClubContext tabs (results/transfers/history), 7-position depth tiles, top-6 scorers, and a right rail with ~16 label/value finance rows and partnerships. Overlaps Klubbhuset, Finance and Squad.
reason: The Club Journal becomes the single Klubben hub landing: identity and history first, departments and board/economy as summaries that link out. It absorbs Klubbhuset (as header art) and replaces the finance spreadsheet with three KPIs, resolving all three overlaps.
dependencies: Season history data for the history strip

alternatives.name: Executive Office
alternatives.concept: A department grid — Trupp, Personal, Ekonomi, Styrelse, Anläggning, Ungdom, Partnerskap — each a status tile with headline number, trend sparkline and responsible staff role.
alternatives.layout: Facts strip → 3×3 department tiles → club context table below.
alternatives.interactions: Tile 'Öppna' link (tile body informs only); hover cards for staff.
alternatives.navigation: Klubben hub root; tiles link to sub-tabs.
pros: Fast overview of the whole organisation

alternatives.name: Clubhouse Rooms
alternatives.concept: The club is its building: the illustrated clubhouse (facility tier art) is the page, and each room opens a full-bleed room panel (Kontoret, Styrelserummet, Ekonomi, Pressrummet, Troférummet).
alternatives.layout: Full-bleed illustration + stacked broadcast panels per room on scroll.
alternatives.interactions: Tap room → camera move to room panel; swipe between rooms on mobile.

alternatives.name: Club Journal
alternatives.concept: The club's own front page: header art (clubhouse at current tier), kicker 'Grundad 1932 · Handbollsligan', a history strip of final positions across every season you managed (and before), department briefs, board mood, three economy KPIs, positional depth court and top scorers.
alternatives.layout: Header → history strip (sparkline of positions with honours stars) → 8/4 grid: department briefs + club context | board dual meter + economy KPIs + partnerships.
alternatives.hierarchy: Identity → trajectory over seasons → what needs attention now.
alternatives.interactions: History strip season → season book; department briefs → Peek; KPI → Finance.
alternatives.navigation: Klubben hub root; Klubbhuset, Partnerskap, Ekonomi, Styrelsen as secondary tabs.
alternatives.mobile: Single column; header shorter; KPIs as 3 chips.
pros: Builds on existing data (history, depth, finance)
cons: History strip empty in season 1 (show club's pre-history if available)

current: Panel 'Klubben i karriärvärlden' with local-state tabs: results (form dots + 8 fixtures), transfers (5-col table), history (4-col table). Tabs reset on navigation.
reason: Results, transfers and seasons are one club story; a filterable timeline reads as narrative and is reusable for other clubs (CLB-04).

alternatives.name: URL Tabs + Tables
alternatives.concept: Keep three tabs but persist in URL, add crests and styled empty states.

alternatives.name: Club Story Timeline
alternatives.concept: One chronological timeline mixing matches (outcome colour), transfers (in/out arrows with player) and season ends (position + honours), filterable by chips.
alternatives.layout: Vertical timeline grouped by month; filter chips.

current: Panel with 16 FinanceRows (revenue split, cash, wages vs budget, budgets, health) at 11–12px with inline styles, plus partnership rows.
reason: Three KPIs and a revenue-mix bar give the club page what it needs and push depth to Finance.

alternatives.name: KPI Trio + Revenue Mix

alternatives.interactions: Tile hover → explanation; link to Finance.

alternatives.hierarchy: Open decision → current standing → the story so far.
alternatives.interactions: Entries expand to show factors at that time; recovery plan entry shows baseline vs now; contract offer resolved inline.

alternatives.navigation: Idag's decision column = the tray; Media stories that involve you link into threads.
alternatives.desktop: Three zones; serif headlines; role emblems.
alternatives.mobile: Tray as top cards, list, full-screen reader with sticky action bar and chain as a collapsible timeline.

current: Row of 9 equal aria-pressed buttons (Alla, Olästa, Åtgärd krävs, Kontrakt, Transfers, Analys, Scouting, Tränarstab, Arkiverat) with no counts.
reason: Three top-level states plus counted category chips match how players triage.

alternatives.name: Segment + Chips
alternatives.concept: Segment Att göra · Allt · Arkiv; below, category chips with counts (Kontrakt 2, Scouting 1…), URL-persisted.

alternatives.name: Sender Lanes
alternatives.concept: Auto-grouped by sender role (Styrelsen, Tränarstab, Scouting, Medicin, Media) as collapsible lanes.

current: Article with data-category, kicker, H2, sender role byline, optional MatchHero/PlayerCell, 13px paragraphs, destination buttons ('Nästa steg'), read/archive tools; empty states 'Välj ett meddelande…' / 'Inga meddelanden i denna vy.'
reason: The reader is where consequences should be visible; a chain rail linking earlier events and the eventual outcome makes every message part of the career story.
dependencies: Consequence log (reputationLog, board factors, press consequences)

alternatives.name: Action-first Reader
alternatives.concept: Decision block on top (options with consequence preview and deadline), body below, entity card (player/match) beside.

alternatives.name: Scene Reader
alternatives.concept: Message rendered as a scene: sender role emblem large, the text as a spoken bubble, rich visuals (match hero, player card, court diagram for tactical notes).

alternatives.name: Thread Reader with Chain Rail
alternatives.concept: Letter-style body with serif headline; a left rail lists the chain for this entity (e.g. 'Skada på träning 12/1 → Fysio: 3 veckor → Du valde vila → Tillbaka 2/2 → Truppen +moral'); decisions inline with consequence preview; once resolved, a 'Följd' stamp shows the outcome and 'Sparat i karriärloggen'.
alternatives.layout: Chain rail (3/12) + letter (9/12) with decision block.
alternatives.interactions: Rail items open earlier messages/Peek; resolve inline; follow-up auto-threads.
alternatives.navigation: Destinations as links, not the only way to act.
alternatives.mobile: Letter full screen; chain as collapsible timeline at top; sticky action bar.
cons: Chain needs consistent event linking (careerEventId exists, consequences partly)

current: Press-room photo hero (top story as headline), 5 tabs (Nyheter, Presskonferenser with open count, Rivaler, Disciplin, Medierna); feed = lead StoryCard + list of typographic cards with scope filter and search. No images; rivals/discipline/outlets are thin lists; news split across Media, Inbox and Dashboard.
reason: A newsstand where each outlet has its own masthead and tier (local paper vs Handbollsmedia vs national) makes the fictional media world legible and cheap to make immersive; your stories link into inbox threads, so news → event → decision connects.

alternatives.name: News Desk
alternatives.concept: A dense, dated news list with outlet, scope, category and your-club flag; filters and search; press conferences as a pinned row.

alternatives.name: Broadcast Feed
alternatives.concept: Image-led social/broadcast feed: match photos, quotes as graphics, live-ish posts after results.
cons: Social feed tone clashes with lower-league local media

alternatives.name: Newsstand
alternatives.concept: Front pages per outlet side by side (local paper, regional, Handbollsmedia, national), each with its masthead style and your club's coverage first; a combined 'Senaste' column; press conferences as a featured slot; tabs become sections (Rivaler, Medierelationer).
alternatives.layout: Featured press slot → outlet front pages row → Senaste column → sections.
alternatives.hierarchy: Your club's headline in each outlet → press slot → others.
alternatives.interactions: Outlet page opens filtered feed; stories link to inbox thread if they concern a decision.
alternatives.navigation: Världen hub; Disciplin moves to player status.
alternatives.mobile: Swipe between outlets; Senaste list below.
pros: Shows how different outlets see you (media favour)

current: Radiogroup scope chips (Alla, Din klubb, Lokalt, Regionalt, Nationellt, Handbollsmedia) + search, lead card + list; no images.
reason: Image-led lead with a dated list is the best balance; it reuses existing match/arena images.

alternatives.name: Image Lead + Dated List
alternatives.concept: Lead story with photo crop and serif headline; list grouped by date with outlet chips.

alternatives.name: Outlet Carousel
alternatives.concept: Carousel of outlet front pages; tap to open that outlet's feed.

current: List of press conference links with title, date and status; open count in tab label.
reason: Open press conferences are decisions; they belong in the Att göra tray and Today, with this tab as an archive of what you said and what it caused.

alternatives.name: Press Calendar
alternatives.concept: Upcoming/open conferences with countdown and status chips; one featured.
cons: Still a separate place to check

alternatives.name: Decisions + Quote Archive
alternatives.concept: Open conferences surface as tray items; the tab shows past conferences as quote cards with their consequences (Truppen +, Styrelsen −, Ditt rykte +).

current: Optional compact 'Öppen fejd' hero + two panels of lists (coach relations, club rivalries).
reason: Rivalries need history and a next meeting to matter.

alternatives.name: Rivalry Cards
alternatives.concept: One card per rival coach/club: relation meter, last flashpoint (quote/match), H2H, next meeting date.

alternatives.name: Heat Map
alternatives.concept: League clubs as a grid coloured by rivalry heat.

current: List of disciplinary cases or 'Inga ärenden.' under Media.
reason: Suspensions are squad availability facts; they belong with the player and squad status, with Media keeping only the story.

alternatives.name: Move to Player Status
alternatives.concept: Cases appear as status chips on players (avstängd 1 match) and in player Peek; Media keeps a small archive.

alternatives.name: Case File
alternatives.concept: Each case with incident, verdict, suspension timeline.

current: Rows of OutletChip, relation value and story count — numbers without meaning.
reason: A favour meter with what it means in coverage tone gives the number a purpose.

alternatives.name: Media Favour Meters
alternatives.concept: Meter per outlet with label ('Välvillig', 'Kritisk') and one line on effect (tone of coverage), last story.
cons: needs new data: plain-language effect copy per range

alternatives.name: Outlet Cards
alternatives.concept: Cards with masthead, tier, relation, story count.

current: Compact press-room hero (pre/post match, date, stamp when closed); consequences panel when closed (Spelaren, Truppen, Styrelsen, Media, Rivalen, Supportrarna, Ditt rykte); ordered list of questions with outlet chip, journalist name, style badge, question and radio answers by tone (CONFIDENT, DIPLOMATIC, CRITICAL, PROVOCATIVE, HUMOROUS, DECLINE) with quote and hint; Delegate / Skip.
reason: Press conferences are frequent, so ceremony must stay low (FM26 lesson), but they are also where the manager's voice creates consequences. The live transcript keeps all questions on one page, answers with one click per question, shows each quote landing and previews which groups react — then becomes the article. B is reserved as an optional 'big match' presentation.

alternatives.name: Rapid Answer Sheet
alternatives.concept: A compact form: each question one row with tone chips (Självsäker, Diplomatisk, Kritisk, Provocerande, Humor, Avböj) and consequence chips on hover; submit all.
alternatives.layout: Rows → Lämna svaren / Delegera / Hoppa över.

alternatives.name: Press Room Scene
alternatives.concept: One question at a time in Floodlight: journalist name and outlet, the room's murmur, your answer cards; after each answer a reaction line and consequence chips animate.
cons: Too much ceremony for every round

alternatives.name: Live Transcript
alternatives.concept: A transcript page: questions appear in order with journalist and outlet; the active question shows tone chips with the quote preview; on answer, your quote is typeset into the transcript and small chips show who will react (Truppen ↑, Rivalen ↑ irritation). When closed it becomes the article with a 'Följder' box that also lands in the career log.
alternatives.layout: Transcript column (8/12) + 'Vem reagerar' meter rail (4/12); footer Delegera / Avböj.
alternatives.hierarchy: Active question → your quotes so far → aggregate reaction.
alternatives.interactions: Click chip or 1–6; Undo before submitting; Delegera hands remaining questions to the assistant.
alternatives.navigation: From tray/Today; ends with link to the article and inbox thread.
alternatives.mobile: Active question card pinned bottom, transcript scrolls above.
cons: Preview must reflect real consequence logic

current: Article: outlet chip, scope, H1, standfirst, byline, body, quote blockquote, destination buttons, fiction note; 'Så skrev andra' list of StoryCards. No image; outlets indistinct.
reason: Outlet-skinned articles (tabloid vs local paper vs Handbollsmedia) make the same event feel different by source at low cost; 'Så skrev andra' remains as a comparison strip.

alternatives.name: Clean Reader
alternatives.concept: Typographic reader with image crop, event links box, related coverage.

alternatives.name: Outlet-skinned Article
alternatives.concept: Masthead and typographic voice per outlet tier (local paper serif, tabloid heavy condensed red, Handbollsmedia web style); body + quote; 'Så skrev andra' strip.

alternatives.name: Why This Story
alternatives.concept: Article with a context box tracing the event chain ('Skrivs efter: 24–29 mot Kristianstad · ditt svar på presskonferensen').

current: PageHeading with prev/next 4-week navigation; context strip; four stacked week panels, each a 7-column grid of 200px day cells (weekday, date, day type badge MATCH/TRAINING/TACTICAL/RECOVERY/REST/TRAVEL, Idag, sessions, match link, deadlines, scouting, milestones) followed by a duplicate fixture table; horizontal scroll on phones. Overlaps Schema and the dashboard weekly plan.
reason: A Week Spine calendar shares one component with the dashboard and the global shell, merges Schema (as the list view) and removes the per-week fixture tables. Month, week and agenda views cover planning, today and phones.

alternatives.name: Planner Grid
alternatives.concept: A dense month grid (5×7) with compact day cells: day-type colour strip, match chip with crest, icons for deadlines/scouting/milestones; side panel shows the selected day.
alternatives.layout: Month grid (9/12) + day panel (3/12); filters for layers.
alternatives.interactions: Click day → panel; layer toggles (Träning, Matcher, Kontrakt, Scouting, Landslag); keyboard arrows.
alternatives.navigation: Tävling/Idag link here; 'Hantera träning' opens week.

alternatives.name: Season Road
alternatives.concept: The season as a road from pre-season to final: weeks as milestones, matches as arenas, transfer windows as toll gates, national breaks as detours, SM-slutspel at the horizon.
alternatives.layout: Horizontal scrolling road with zoom; current week centred.
patterns: Play menu as season state machine

d: Season road: försäsong → serie → fönster → SM|12|timeline

alternatives.name: Week Spine Calendar
alternatives.concept: The full form of the global Week Spine: the current week expanded (day cells with type, sessions, match, pins) above a zoomable season strip (weeks as ticks, matches, windows, national breaks, playoffs). Views: Vecka · Månad · Lista (Lista = today's Schema).
alternatives.layout: View switch → expanded week (12) → season strip (12) → selected day/fixture Peek.
alternatives.hierarchy: Today and this week → next 4 pins → season horizon.
alternatives.interactions: Click season tick → jump week; drag across weeks to preview; pins open Peek; 'Hantera träning' per week; Continue moves the marker.
alternatives.navigation: Shell spine expands into this page; Schema becomes the Lista view.
alternatives.desktop: Week 7×1 cells (no 200px height), season strip below.
alternatives.mobile: Agenda list per day with sticky week header; season strip swipeable.
cons: Component must handle dense weeks (match + travel + deadline)
patterns: Play menu as season state machine

d: Season strip: veckor · matcher · fönster · SM|12|timeline

current: SectionScene header; PreseasonPlanner form section at the top year-round; filter tabs; 8-column fixture table (Omg, Datum, Typ, H/B, Motstånd, Status, Resultat, link) without crests; rail with next-match panel. Nav label 'Schema' vs title 'Matcher & resultat'.
reason: Fixtures are a view of time; as the calendar's Lista view they share filters and Peek, and the pre-season planner appears only in pre-season.

alternatives.name: Fixture Table with Crests
alternatives.concept: Keep a dedicated page: crests in rows, outcome colours, URL filters, planner removed from the top.

alternatives.name: Fixture Cards
alternatives.concept: Cards per match with crests, venue image, outcome colour, competition mark.

alternatives.name: Calendar List View
alternatives.concept: No separate page: 'Lista' view of the Week Spine Calendar with chips (Hela säsongen · Kommande · Resultat · Tävling), crests, outcome colours.
cons: Players used to a fixtures page must learn the view

current: Plan section with cash intro, anchor-based sub-tabs (Träningsmatch / Läger-resa / Turnering), form grid, cost line and booked events list; shown year-round.
reason: Pre-season booking is a calendar activity: empty pre-season weeks as slots you fill gives a spatial plan and cost visibility.

alternatives.name: Preseason Board on Calendar
alternatives.concept: During pre-season the calendar shows empty slots; click a slot → drawer to book friendly/camp/tournament with cost vs cash.

alternatives.name: Preseason Wizard
alternatives.concept: A 3-step wizard at season start: matcher → läger → turnering, with a cost summary.
alternatives.navigation: Part of the 'Ny säsong' front page.

current: aria-pressed tab buttons (Hela säsongen / Kommande / Resultat), not URL-persisted; empty row 'Inga matcher i den här vyn.'
reason: Filters should be shared with the calendar list view.

alternatives.name: URL Segmented Control
alternatives.concept: Same three filters as a segmented control persisted in URL.

alternatives.name: Calendar Chips
alternatives.concept: Filters as chips in the calendar's list view, combinable with competition chips.
